title: feat(spec): the position form picks permissionSets from the permission-set registry (ref-multi:permission), with the console pin moved to 4997995022f8
body:
Fixes #22682
Clause-②: no

Item 3 of #22682, the card's last `packages/spec` item (items 1 and 2 landed with PR #22710 as `b32ee3eaf3`). ADR-0131 D4, verbatim: "References to declared items are **by machine name**, resolved registry-first." The position form is the one authoring surface for the position to permission-set binding, and its `permissionSets` row (added by PR #22723 as `type: 'tags'`, a free-text tag box) now names the permission-set registry picker, so the designer offers the declared set names instead of free text.

This PR now also moves the bundled Console's objectui pin to `4997995022f8`, objectui#12136's merge (objectui#12126), which registers the `ref-multi:permission` widget. That is landing order B from seat 1's ACCEPT `6106524871` on #22682: the objectui widget first, then the pin, then this row. Triage's unlock `6108789665` put the pin bump into this PR.

- **Round 1** (accepted): claim `6105901038` (seat `domain:spec#1`), base `e84aeb36ce`, accepted at `8996b566b5` by ACCEPT `6106524871`. The three files of that round are unchanged here.
- **Landing round:** claim `6109075588` (seat `domain:spec#3`, session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`), branch `claude/issue-22682-position-permission-sets-picker` continued from `8996b566b5`. It merges `main` (`aa734f0924` onto `efcbac73cc`, then `483fddb3fc` onto `1eff3224d7`, both through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`), and adds one pin-bump commit, `aaa50c66ec`.

## What changes

- **The row** (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.form.ts`): `{ field: 'permissionSets', type: 'tags', colSpan: 2, helpText: … }` becomes `{ field: 'permissionSets', widget: 'ref-multi:permission', colSpan: 2, helpText: … }`, with a comment saying why. The helpText is unchanged. No other row, section or form changes.
- **One pin** (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.test.ts`, a new `describe` at the end, 4 tests). It reads the position form through `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`, the registry `/meta/types` serves, which holds the output of `defineForm`'s parse, so a parse that dropped `widget` would also turn it red. It asserts:
  - a lit and a dark control for the row probe;
  - exactly one `permissionSets` row, whose `widget` is `ref-multi:permission`;
  - the registry type the key names is `permission`, and `getMetadataTypeSchema('permission')` is `PermissionSetSchema`;
  - `permissionSets` refuses a bare string with `invalid_type` at `permissionSets`, so the list-valued key sits on a list-valued field.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`.
- ⛔ No schema, parse, export or accept-set change. `PositionSchema` is untouched (`permissionSets` stays `z.array(SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema).optional()`), the approver bindings are untouched, and `FormField.widget` stays `z.string().optional()`: the spec has no form widget-key vocabulary, so no published vocabulary is added. No objectui file.
- **The pin hop** (commit `aaa50c66ec`, 20 files, +312 / -83): `.objectui-sha` from `0df67f237c5a` to `4997995022f8`, with its regeneration. The next section has the details.

## The console pin: `0df67f237c5a` to `4997995022f8`

This moves the bundled Console's objectui pin from `0df67f237c5a` (PR #22812) to `4997995022f8e65946f6362b7434685539cc72b7`, objectui#12136's merge (objectui#12126): metadata-admin registers `ref-multi:permission`, so the position form's `permissionSets` row renders a multi-picker of the declared permission sets instead of the raw-JSON fallback.

This is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is untouched, and this diff edits neither `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md` nor `packages/console/package.json`. The console's release input is the new `.changeset/console-4997995022f8.md`.

### Range

- **REST `compare` on objectstack-ai/objectui**, `0df67f237c5a...4997995022f8` (read 2026-10-11T12:55:58Z): `status: ahead`, `ahead_by: 7`, `behind_by: 0`, 80 files, merge base `0df67f237c5a`.
- In a scratch repository that borrows the objectui object store, `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4997995022 origin/main` exits 0 (objectui `main` read at `1d1cfe0c119e`, 2026-10-11T12:39:18Z). `0df67f237c5a..4997995022f8` has 7 commits and 0 merges. Its 80 paths are 17 added, 62 modified, 1 renamed and 0 deleted.
- **Why this commit and not a later one:** it is the nearest objectui `main` commit that carries the widget, as the dispatch ruled. objectui `main` has two more commits (`9b75509`, `1d1cfe0`). I measured no reason to take them, so this bump does not chase them.

### What each commit brings, and which regenerated change it causes

| `802f0bc` (objectui#5250 slice C, the strict authoring face) | repairs the keys the strict authoring face refuses in objectui's examples | examples JSON and `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts` only. No record cites them. Its one regenerated effect is a corpus control: `timeout` 1705 to 1704 in two migration entries |
| `1071393` (objectui#12098) | marketplace install answers say what the runtime served | app-shell marketplace and the locale packs: the calendar record's pack sentence; corpus counts |
| `7525045` (objectui#12082 leg A) | more write affordances read the affordance-to-grant map | `ObjectGrid.tsx` (+14 / -3: a bulk `update` def needs the edit verdict) and `ObjectGantt.tsx` (+27 / -4): hop sentences in five gantt records and the grid records |
| `c9fc10b` (objectui#12121) | a boolean with a CEL default is left to the server on create | `form.tsx` (+37 / -25): the form-layout record's call-site anchor moves `:3246` to `:3258` |
| `66eb560` (objectui#12131 phase 1, the strict authoring face) | docs stop teaching keys the strict authoring face refuses | README, docs pages and one renamed example. No record cites them, and no corpus count moves |

Neither of the two strict-authoring-face commits touches a registered component, so neither moves the SDUI manifest.

### What the regeneration changed (20 files)

| file | written by | gate that required it |

| `.changeset/console-4997995022f8.md` | the same run (the digest): 5 releasing changesets of 5, 2 commits without a changeset, highest level `minor` | `check:objectui-changeset`, Check Changeset |
| `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` over `.cache/objectui-4997995022f8` | `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` |
| `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` | `node scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs --update`, `OBJECTUI_ROOT` at the built tree | `check:sdui-lockstep` |
| 55 asserting citations: 49 in 14 committed files under `packages/spec/src`, and 6 in the generated `registry.ts` | re-measured by hand (below) | `check:objectui-pin-citations` (and `--verify-anchors`) |

- **`sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical** (`cmp` against the tracked file: equal). It keeps 107 components and sha256 `9d87162a3ef6…`. Only its record moves: `objectuiSha` and `modulesRoot`.
- The lockstep records 214 grammar lines (blob `0131f27cf86d`), 25 diagnostic codes and containment predicate `76c18fb95d1f`. All are unchanged; objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` is untouched by the range, so no port is owed. Only `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` move.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is gitignored and regenerated (`gen:migration-registry`), not committed.
- The bump script and the console build read objectui through a scratch repository with no refs of the shared checkout's own, borrowing its object store as an alternate. So nothing was written into the shared objectui checkout.

### How the citations were re-measured

- **Method.** Each asserting record's cited objectui files were resolved at `0df67f237c5a` and intersected with the range's 80 changed paths. A record whose cited files are all byte-identical (`git diff --quiet`) gains that sentence and no re-pointing: 29 records. The other 20 were re-read one by one.
- **Changed cited files:** `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.tsx` and `form.tsx`, plus the `en` / `zh` / `de` packs, whose `calendar.configRequired` lines hash the same at both pins. Every cited line in them moved or held byte-identical, measured by exact-text search of each old range in the new file:
  - `ObjectGrid.tsx`: the selection block `4897-4924` to `4981-5008`, still hashing to `c88443302d40`; `:1786` to `:1787`; `:1850` to `:1851`; `:5097-5116` to `:5165-5184`; `:5132` to `:5200`; `:5570` to `:5615`; `:6587-6588` to `:6632-6633`; `:6604-6605` to `:6649-6650`.

- **Readings beside a cited read**, each said in its hop sentence:
  - `ObjectGrid.tsx` (objectui#12082): a bulk `update` def is now withheld unless the edit verdict allows it. That narrows the declared defs and adds no implicit one, so the `sys_api_key` reading in `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` holds.
  - `ObjectGantt.tsx` (objectui#12082): the in-chart write handlers are withheld without the grant. The renderer's `schema.*` read set is the same 49 names at both pins, so no declared key set moves.

  - `ObjectKanban.tsx`'s `quickAdd` / `onQuickAdd` / `onCardClick`: 2 / 2 / 11. No `'kanban-ui'` literal in objectui's non-test sources at either pin.
  - The `ElementDataSourceGate` occurrences in the five `src/index.tsx` shells: 0, 3, 3, 4 and 3, all five shells byte-identical.
- **Corpus counts.** The six migration entries' counts were re-taken with `git grep -o -F`. That method first reproduced every `0df67f237c5a` number: 8424 files, `objectstack` 18248, `@objectstack/spec` 7582, `useState` 2645, `timeout` 1705, `RuntimeConfig` 347, `resourceLimits` 2, `window` 4596, `period` 251, `interval` 233, `metrics` 456, `Span` 517, `SpanSchema` 57, `TTL` 184 and `tenant` 1357.
  - At the new pin they read: 8441 files, `objectstack` 18271, `@objectstack/spec` 7587, `useState` 2648, `timeout` 1704, `RuntimeConfig` 352, `resourceLimits` 2 (the same two `packages/app-shell` hits), `window` 4604, `period` 251, `interval` 238, `metrics` 456, `Span` 517, `SpanSchema` 57, `TTL` 184 and `tenant` 1362.

### Clause-②: the pin hop moves no published contract, measured

- **`.zod.ts` accept sets, defaults and exports:** none moves. Each of the 14 changed `.ts` files under `packages/spec/src` was scanned with the TypeScript scanner at `aa734f0924` and at the head, comments skipped and every string, template and regular-expression literal replaced by one placeholder token. The token sequences are identical in 12 of the 14. The other two, `18.system-metrics-jsdoc-durations-unit-in-key.ts` and `18.system-tracing-otel-exporter-durations-unit-in-key.ts`, each gain one `+` joining one new string fragment (the older count) into a `reason` string. No identifier, key, value or export moves. The one shipped `describe` that changes is `FormField.span`'s, and only its sha moves.
- **Baselines:** `check:api-surface` ("public API surface + factory signatures unchanged") and `check:authorable-surface` are green, and `check:generated` reads "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- **The html tier:** the SDUI manifest the save gate and `os validate` compile against is byte-identical, so no page source changes verdict.
- So the hop's line is `Clause-②: no`, the same as this PR's line 2 and as both new changesets. No line in this body moves.

### The widget renders at the new pin

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx:3242` is `export const WIDGETS = {`, and `:3246` is `'ref-multi:permission': RefMultiPermissionWidget,`. `WIDGET_LABELLING` declares it `'group'` at `:3358`. The key is absent from `widgets.tsx` at `0df67f237c5a`.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx:1001-1004` loads the `permission` catalog (`client.list('permission')`) only when the form on screen declares the widget, which the position form now does.

## The key: `ref-multi:permission`, measured

objectui readings are `git show` in a read-only clone, at objectui `origin/main` `206505c` and at this repo's pin `.objectui-sha` `20c6d351ad74`; both read the same at every line cited.

| question | reading |
|:--|:--|
| Does a multi-value `ref:` spelling exist anywhere? | No. Census of quoted `ref:` widget literals: this repo has `ref:object`, `ref:dataset` and `ref:component` only; objectui has the same three. All three are single-valued. |
| How does the vocabulary spell a multi-value picker? | As its own key: `field-ref` / `field-multi`, `select` / `multiselect`, and `action-multi`. No key in either repo serves both arities. |
| Can objectui's single `ref:` widgets take an array? | No. `RefObjectWidget`, `RefComponentWidget` and `RefDatasetWidget` (`widgets.tsx:464`, `:607`, `:684`) each read `String(value)` and write one string. The registry also declares ONE labelling per key (`WIDGET_LABELLING`, `widgets.tsx:3142`): the single `ref:` pickers are `'control'`, while `field-multi`, `action-multi` and `multiselect` are `'group'`. |
| Which registry type names permission sets? | `permission`, on both sides. Spec: `MetadataTypeSchema` (`kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:166`), the `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` row labelled `Permission Set` (`:1117`), and `getMetadataTypeSchema('permission')` returns `PermissionSetSchema`. objectui: `registerMetadataResource({ type: 'permission', … })` (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:28`), and `anchors.ts:374`. |
| Does `type: 'tags'` override an explicit widget? | No. `inferWidget` returns an explicit `fieldSpec.widget` first (`SchemaForm.tsx:447`). `tags` maps to `string-tags` only when no widget is declared (`:467`). So the row drops `type`, matching every other `ref:` and `-multi` row in the spec forms, none of which declares a `type`. |

So the key is a distinct list key in the `ref:` family. The prefix carries the arity, and the token after the colon is the exact registry type, so the same split reads `ref:object` and `ref-multi:permission`.

Alternatives considered:
- `ref:permission` on the array field, with the arity read from the schema. It is one key per type, but no widget in the vocabulary is arity-polymorphic, a single `ref:` widget writes a string into a list, and one key would have to carry one labelling for two shapes.
- `permission-multi`, mirroring `field-multi`. It drops the `ref:` namespace the claim names.
- `ref:permission-multi`. The token after the colon would no longer be a registry type.

## What objectui rendered for this key before the pin moved, and the landing order

Round 1's reading, measured by code path at objectui `206505c` and at the then pin `20c6d351ad74`:
- The position editor is the generic `ResourceEditPage`. Its form is `entry?.form` from `/meta/types` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:456`, `:457`, `:2943`). Position registers only a preview (`previews/index.ts:87`), not an edit page. So the key reaches every console as soon as the server runs this spec.
- `WIDGETS` (`widgets.tsx:3033`) had no `ref-multi:permission` entry. `resolveFieldFace` therefore sent an unregistered, non-passthrough hint to the `raw-json` face (`SchemaForm.tsx:870`), rendered at `:2223`: a JSON textarea under the note `widget ref-multi:permission — falling back to JSON until a custom renderer is registered.` (`i18n.ts:2166`).
- No objectui test pins "every widget key a spec form names is registered", so the change turned no objectui gate red; it would have degraded to the announced fallback.
- Precedent: objectui#11601 records the same shape for `ref:dataset`, and the joined-block row in #21714 declared `ref:dataset` only after the pin carried the renderer.

Seat 1 set landing order B in ACCEPT `6106524871`: the objectui companion first, then the pin, then this row. The companion was filed as objectui#12126 and landed as objectui#12136 (`4997995022`). This PR now carries the pin as well, so the row and the widget that renders it ship in one console build. The section above has the reading at the new pin.

## Acceptance notes

- **The pin hop moves no published contract** (measured above), so it adds no `Clause-②` line of its own. Both new changesets say `Clause-②: no`. The console changeset is `minor` because objectui declared `minor` for three of its five entries.
- **objectui `main` is two commits past the pin** (`9b75509`, objectui#5250 slice B; `1d1cfe0`, objectui#12106). Neither is needed here.
- **Cloud's own `.objectui-sha`** is untouched; this PR moves only this repository's pin.
- **Writes this round:** `git push` (no force) of three commits; one body and title update and one assignee swap on this PR (`zhuangjianguo` replaces `os-project-manager`, mirroring the card), both through `scripts/pm/`; no label; no MCP write.
